embedded_ivos.text:
The unchecked development of AI by reckless, for-profit corporations and Big Tech oligarchs threatens our economy, democracy, and humanity itself.

Congress must act to ban AI superintelligence, pause data center construction and advanced AI development, mandate independent oversight, and much more.

deepseek.reason: The statement calls for independent oversight but not embedded IVOs with ongoing on-site internal access.
deepseek.confidence_reason: It supports general independent oversight, which is not the narrower embedded-IVO policy.
